prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1293; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a multi-lane roadway in Houston, Texas, when Driver 2 moved into the same lane without signaling and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. The impact produced a clear sideswipe pattern, and the damage visible on both vehicles is consistent with the reported collision. Photographs taken at the scene document the area of contact and the resting positions of both vehicles. No independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the statements of the drivers and the scene evidence. Responding officers confirmed that Passenger was seated in the front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the crash. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain shortly after the collision and was evaluated at the scene. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as an insured operator on the policy associated with the vehicle. The injuries described are consistent with the type and force of the impact observed.
